# Estimate Beta Diversity

Load packages

```{r}
pkgs = readRDS("data/Rpkgs.Rds")
install.packages(setdiff(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages())))
lapply(pkgs, require, character.only = TRUE)
```

```{r}
load("data/data.Rdata")
set.seed(4480)

# keep sample metadatabut rewrite with filters
sample_metadata = sample_metadata3

library(mvabund)
```

```{r}
genome_gifts <- genome_gifts_raw[rownames(genome_gifts_raw) %in% genome_counts_filt$genome,]
genome_gifts <- genome_gifts[, colSums(genome_gifts != 0) > 0]
```


## Hill Number Distance Matrices

Run hillpair using only the S Matrix that calculates Jaccard-type turnover.

```{r}
genome_counts = 
  genome_counts %>%
  select(genome, sample_metadata$sample)


beta_q0n <- genome_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  hillpair(., q = 0, 
           metric = "S")
attr(beta_q0n,"Labels") <- colnames(genome_counts)[-1]

beta_q1n <- genome_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  hillpair(., q = 1, metric = "S")
attr(beta_q1n,"Labels") <- colnames(genome_counts)[-1]

genome_counts <- genome_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0))%>%
  rownames_to_column(., "genome")

genome_tree <- keep.tip(genome_tree, tip=genome_counts$genome)

beta_q1p <- genome_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  hillpair(., q = 1, tree = genome_tree, metric = "S")
attr(beta_q1p,"Labels") <- colnames(genome_counts)[-1]

genome_counts_filt <- genome_counts[genome_counts$genome %in% rownames(genome_gifts),]
genome_counts_filt <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  remove_rownames() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0))%>%
  rownames_to_column(., "genome")

genome_gifts <- genome_gifts_raw[rownames(genome_gifts_raw) %in% genome_counts_filt$genome,]
genome_gifts <- genome_gifts[, colSums(genome_gifts != 0) > 0]

genome_gifts1 <- genome_gifts[rownames(genome_gifts) %in% genome_counts_filt$genome,]
genome_gifts1 <- genome_gifts1[, colSums(genome_gifts1 != 0) > 0]

dist <- genome_gifts1 %>%
  to.elements(., GIFT_db) %>%
  traits2dist(., method = "gower")

beta_q1f <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  remove_rownames() %>% 
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  hillpair(., q = 1, dist = dist, metric = "S")
attr(beta_q1f,"Labels") <- colnames(genome_counts)[-1]
```

#### Geographic Location

```{r}
sample_metadata$pc1 = 
  prcomp(sample_metadata[,c("latitude","longitude")])$x[,1]
```


v## Habitat Comparison

### Permanova analysis

Because both the overdispersion and PERMANOVA result are significant, we cannot conclude that one is because of significant differences or due to differences in dispersion between habitats. However, a PERMANOVA is considered to be robust against heterogeneous dispersions *when* the sample design is balanced as is the case in this study.

Anderson, M. J., & Walsh, D. C. (2013). PERMANOVA, ANOSIM, and the Mantel test in the face of heterogeneous dispersions: what null hypothesis are you testing?. Ecological monographs, 83(4), 557-574.

```{r}
set.seed(4458)
```

#### Richness

```{r}
sample_metadata_row<- column_to_rownames(sample_metadata, "sample") 
# Test for overdispersion
beta_q0n_disp =
betadisper(
  beta_q0n, # Uses Matrix S (Jaccard-type turnover)
  sample_metadata_row$habitat) %>% 
  permutest(., pairwise = TRUE) 
beta_q0n_disp
```

Results from the Beta Dispersal test suggest that microbiome diversity among one of the habitats is over dispersed, and therefore defies the PERMANOVA's assumption of homogeneous dispersion.  

```{r}
beta_Hq0n = 
adonis2(beta_q0n ~ habitat + (1 | pc1), 
        data = sample_metadata %>% arrange(match(sample,labels(beta_q0n))), 
        permutations = 9999)
beta_Hq0n
```


```{r}
g_beta_q0n = 
  
beta_q0n %>%
  vegan::metaMDS(., trymax = 500, k = 2, trace=0) %>%
  vegan::scores() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
  group_by(habitat) %>%
  mutate(x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = habitat)) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = diet_colors,labels=c("Pre_grass" = "Captive-bred no grass diet", "Post_grass" = "Captive-bred grass diet", "Wild" = "Wild"))+
    #   stat_ellipse(aes(color = beta_q1n_nmds$Groups))+
    geom_segment(aes(x = x_cen, y = y_cen, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2), alpha = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_color_manual(name = 'habitat', 
                     values = c("rural" = '#5bae63',"urban" = '#986eac'),
                     drop = FALSE) +
    # add significance from permanova
        labs(x = paste("p =",beta_Hq0n$`Pr(>F)`[1]), y = "")+ 
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position="none"
      #legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +labs(color='Origin')

g_beta_q0n
```


## Geographic Correlation

Therefore, consider including a multivariate analysis (e.g. mvabund) instead.

```{r}
# convert genome counts into an mvabund object format
mvabund_genome =
  mvabund(
  genome_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0))
  )

# create a model with mvabund object as response variable (after transposition)
mod1 <- 
  manyglm(t(mvabund_genome) ~ 
            as.factor(sample_metadata$habitat) + # define the predictor variable
            # use spatial coordinates as covariates
            #prcomp(sample_metadata[,c("latitude","longitude")])$x[,1],
            poly(sample_metadata$latitude) + 
            poly(sample_metadata$longitude),
          # negative binomial found to be better fit
            family = "negative_binomial") 
plot(mod1)

# run analysis of variance
anova(mod1)
```

In this case, habitat and geolocation are all significant. Suggesting that distance could just as easily explain the results and habitat type.

## Site Comparisons

### Permanova analysis & Beta diversity plots

```{r}
set.seed(4458)

# separate by habitat
habitats = levels(as.factor(sample_metadata_row$habitat))

habitat_col = list(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(3,"YlGn"),
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(3,"BuPu")
)
```



```{r}
sample_metadata_row<- column_to_rownames(sample_metadata, "sample") 
```

#### Richness

Test for differences in richness among all sites.

```{r}
beta_IDq0n_disp =
betadisper(beta_q0n, sample_metadata_row$event_id) %>% permutest(., pairwise = TRUE) 
beta_IDq0n_disp

beta_IDq0n = 
adonis2(beta_q0n ~ event_id + (1 | pc1), 
        data = sample_metadata %>% arrange(match(sample,labels(beta_q0n))), 
        permutations = 9999)

beta_IDq0n
```
##### sperate by habitat

```{r}
beta_q0n_H = list()
bdHp_q0n = list()

for (h in seq_along(habitats)){

genome_names =  c("genome",
                  colnames(genome_counts)[
                    colnames(genome_counts) %in% rownames(sample_metadata_row[sample_metadata_row$habitat==habitats[h],])])
  
# make new beta diversity matrix
beta_q0n_H[[h]] <- 
  genome_counts[,genome_names] %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  hillpair(., q = 0,  metric = "S")
attr(beta_q0n_H[[h]],"Labels") <- genome_names[-1]


bdH =  betadisper(beta_q0n_H[[h]],
                  sample_metadata_row[sample_metadata_row$habitat==habitats[h],]$event_id) %>%
  permutest(., pairwise = TRUE)
adH =  adonis2(beta_q0n_H[[h]] ~ event_id + (1 | pc1), 
        data = sample_metadata[sample_metadata$habitat==habitats[h],] %>% arrange(match(sample,labels(beta_q0n_H[[h]]))), 
        permutations = 9999)

bdHp_q0n[[h]] = 
  beta_q0n_H[[h]] %>%
  vegan::metaMDS(., trymax = 500, k = 2, trace=0) %>%
  vegan::scores() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
  group_by(event_id) %>%
  mutate(x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate_at(c('event_id'), as.factor)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = factor(event_id, levels = c("MIND","CNSC","PAVI","CTAT","PCAR","SMAT")))) +
    geom_point(show.legend = TRUE, size = 4) +
     scale_color_manual(name = 'Site', 
                     values = c("MIND" = '#add4a0', "CNSC" = '#5bae63', "PAVI" = '#1a7939', 
                                "CTAT" = '#c3a4cf', "PCAR" = '#986eac', "SMAT" = '#742881'),
                     drop = FALSE)+
  
  #   stat_ellipse(aes(color = beta_q1n_nmds$Groups))+
    geom_segment(aes(x = x_cen, y = y_cen, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2), alpha = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = paste("p = ",adH$`Pr(>F)`[1]), y = "") +
    theme(
      #axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      #axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +labs(color='Origin')

print(bdH)
print(adH)
}
print(bdHp_q0n)

```

```{r}
      axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +labs(color='Origin')

print(bdH)
print(adH)
}
print(bdHp_q1n)
```

##### sperate by habitat

```{r}
beta_q1p_H = list()
bdHp_q1p = list()

for (h in seq_along(habitats)){

genome_names = c("genome",
                 colnames(genome_counts)[colnames(genome_counts) %in%                                         rownames(sample_metadata_row[sample_metadata_row$habitat==habitats[h],])])
  
# make new beta diversity matrix
beta_q1p_H[[h]] <- genome_counts[,genome_names] %>%
 column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  hillpair(., q = 1, tree = genome_tree, metric = "S")
attr(beta_q1p_H[[h]],"Labels") <- genome_names[-1]

bdH =  betadisper(beta_q1p_H[[h]], sample_metadata_row[sample_metadata_row$habitat==habitats[h],]$event_id) %>% 
  permutest(., pairwise = TRUE)
adH =  adonis2(beta_q1p_H[[h]] ~ event_id + (1 | pc1), 
        data = sample_metadata[sample_metadata$habitat==habitats[h],] %>% arrange(match(sample,labels(beta_q1p_H[[h]]))), 
        permutations = 9999)

bdHp_q1p[[h]] = 
  beta_q1p_H[[h]] %>%
  vegan::metaMDS(., trymax = 500, k = 2, trace=0) %>%
  vegan::scores() %>%
  as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
  group_by(event_id) %>%
  mutate(x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate_at(c('event_id'), as.factor)%>%
   ggplot(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = factor(event_id, levels = c("MIND","CNSC","PAVI","CTAT","PCAR","SMAT")))) +
    geom_point(show.legend = TRUE, size = 4) +
    scale_color_manual(name = 'Site', 
                     values = c("MIND" = '#add4a0', "CNSC" = '#5bae63', "PAVI" = '#1a7939', 
                                "CTAT" = '#c3a4cf', "PCAR" = '#986eac', "SMAT" = '#742881'),
                     drop = FALSE)+
    #   stat_ellipse(aes(color = beta_q1n_nmds$Groups))+
    geom_segment(aes(x = x_cen, y = y_cen, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2), alpha = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    theme_classic() +
        labs(x = paste("p = ",adH$`Pr(>F)`[1]), y = "") +
    theme(
      #axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      #axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +labs(color='Origin')

print(bdH)
print(adH)
}
print(bdHp_q1p)
```
